(fr. सं-√ चित्) agreement, compact, stipulation, assignation with (gen., esp. with a lover), engagement, appointment (acc. with √ कृ, or ग्रह् or दा or Caus. of √ कॢप्, ‘to make an agreement or appointment’ or ‘appoint a place of meeting with any person’ [gen. or instr. or instr. with सह, समम्, मिथः]; ibc. ‘according to agreement’, ‘by appointment’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
convention, consent, MBh.

a short explanation of a grammatical rule (= 2. शैली, q.v.), MW.
condition, provision, ib.

a: संकेतः — 1 An intimation, allusion. --2 A sign, gesture, hint; Mu. 1. --3 An indicatory sign, mark, token. --4 Agreement, convention; संकेतो गृह्यते जातौ गुणद्रव्यक्रियासु च S. D. 12. --5 Engagement, appointment, assignation (made by a mistress or lover); नामसमेतं कृतसंकेतं वादयते मृदु वेणुं Gīt. 5. --6 A place of meeting (for lovers), rendezvous; कांतार्थिनी तु या याति संकेतं साभिसारिका Ak. --7 Condition, provision. --8 A short explanatory rule (in gram.). --Comp. --गृहं, --निकेतनं, --स्थानं a place of appointment or assignation; rendezvous.

m: सं-केत—भूमि f. = -केतन, Vās.
सं-केत—शिक्षा f. N. of a Tantra wk.
सं-केत—चन्द्रोदय m.

सं-केत—कौमुदी f. N. of wk.
संकेतक m. an agreement, appointment, rendezvous, Mṛcch.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
a: संकेतकः — 1 Agreement, convention. --2 Appointment, assignation. --3 Rendezvous. --4 A lover or mistress who makes an appointment; संकेतके चिरयति प्रवरो विनोदः Mk. 3. 3.

m: सं-केत—केतन n. a place of assignation, place appointed for meeting (a lover &c.), rendezvous, Kathās.
सं-केत—मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
सं-केत—मिलित mfn. met by appointment, Kathās.
सं˚केतन n. id., Vet.
a: संकेतनं — 1 Appointment, agreement. --2 A rendezvous.

सं-केत—यामल n. N. of a Tantra wk.

a: संकेतयति — Den. P. 1 To agree upon, appoint. --2 To fix by convention, lay down conventionally. --3 To invite, call. --4 To give a hint.

m: संकेतित mfn. agreed upon, fixed, settled, Prāyaśc.; Sāh.
invited, MW.
a: संकेतित — a. 1 Agreed upon, fixed by convention; साक्षात्संकेतितं योऽर्थमभिधत्ते स वाचकः K. P. 2. --2 Invited, called.

m: संकेतोद्यान n. a park or garden appointed as a rendezvous, Kathās.

(= सं-स्कृ, q.v.) : Pass. -क्रियते (aor. सम्-अकारि), RV. : Caus. -कारयति, to cause to arrange or prepare, celebrate (a wedding), MBh.; to make, render (two acc.), ib.
a: संकृ — {c8c} U. (संकुरुते) 1 To commit; ये पक्षापरपक्षदोषसहिताः पापानि संकुर्वते Mk. 9. 4. --2 To manufacture, prepare. --3 To do. perform in general.

m: सं-√ 2. कृत् (only ind.p. -कृत्य and -कर्तम्), to cut to pieces, cut through, pierce, ŚBr.
सं-कृति mfn. putting together, arranging, preparing, making ready, TS.; TBr.
सं-कृति m. N. of various men (pl. ‘the family of S˚’; cf. g. गर्गादि), ŚrS.; MBh. &c.
सं-कृति f. a kind of metre (consisting of 4 Pādas of 24 syllables each), RPrāt.; Col.
सं-कृति n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
सं-कृत्त mfn. cut to pieces, cut through, pierced, MBh.
सं-√ कृष् P. Ā. -कर्षति, ˚ते, to draw together, contract, tighten, AV.; TS.; KātyŚr.; to draw away, drag along, carry off, MBh.; R.
a: संकृष् — {c1c} P. 1 To drag along or away. --2 To contract. --3 To tighten, tie fast.

m: सं-कृष्ट mfn. drawn together, contracted (as two sounds), drawn near to one another, KātyŚr.
सं-किल m. (said to be fr. शम् + √ किल्) a burning torch, fire-brand, L.
a: संकिलः — A fire brand, burning torch.

m: सं-क्लेश m. pain, suffering, affliction, MBh.; R. &c.
सं-˚क्लेशन n. causing pain, Car.
सं-क्लेश—निर्वाण n. cessation of afflictions, MW.
सं-क्लेद mfn. excessive wetness or moisture, saturation with (comp.), R.; Hariv. &c.
moisture (supposed to be the first stage of putrefaction), Car.
a fluid secretion (supposed to form upon conception and become the rudiment of the fetus), Yājñ.
a: संक्लेदः — 1 Dampness, moisture. --2 The fluid secretion supposed to form in the first month after conception and which constitutes the rudiment of the fœtus.

m: सं-√ क्लिश् P. -क्लिश्नाति (only inf. -क्लेष्टुम् and ind.p. -क्लिश्य), to press together, ŚBr.; to torment, pain, afflict, R. : Pass. -क्लिश्यते, to get soiled, Divyāv. (cf. next).
सं-क्लिन्न mfn. (√ क्लिद्) thoroughly wet or moistened, Gṛhyās.; Mṛcch.
सं-क्लिष्ट mfn. pressed together &c.
contused or bruised (as the flesh without injury to the skin), Suśr.
covered with mould or mildew, tarnished (as a mirror), Car.
beset with difficulties (see next)
सं-क्लिष्ट—कर्मन् mfn. one who does everything with trouble or difficulty, MBh.
सं-कोच m. contraction, shrinking together, compression, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
shutting up, closing (of the eyes), Sāh.
crouching down, cowering, humbling one's self, shyness, fear (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to become shy or modest’), Hariv.
abridgment, diminution, limitation, restriction, Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
drying up (of a lake), Kāv.
binding, tying, L.
a sort of skate fish, L.
N. of an Asura, MBh.
सं-कोच n. saffron, L.
सं-कोच &c. See सं-√ कुच्.
a: संकोचः — 1 Contraction, shrinking up. --2 Abridgment, diminution, compression. --3 Terror, fear. --4 Shutting up, closing. --5 Binding. --6 A kind of skate-fish. --चं Saffron. --Comp. --पिशुनं saffron.

m: सं-कोच—कारिन् mfn. making contraction, crouching down, humble, modest, Rājat.
सं-˚कोचक mfn. contracting, causing to shrink or shrivel up, Kāvyād., Sch.
सं-˚कोचनी f. the sensitive plant (Mimosa Pudica), L.
सं-˚कोचनीय mfn. to be limited or restricted (-त्व n.), Nyāyam., Sch.
सं-˚कोचनीय—त्व n.
सं-˚कोचन mf(ई)n. (see गात्र-संकोचनी) id.
astringent, MW.
सं-˚कोचन m. N. of a mountain, R.
सं-˚कोचन n. the act of contracting or closing or astringing, MBh.; Suśr.; Sāh.
a: संकोचनं — Contraction. --नी The sensitive plant.

m: सं-कोच—पत्त्रक mfn. causing the withering of leaves (said of a partic. disease affecting trees), Hariv.
सं-कोच—पिशुन n. saffron, L.
सं-कोच—रेखा f. ‘line of contraction’, a wrinkle, fold, L.
सं-˚कोचिन् mfn. closing (as a flower), Rājat.
contracting (see गात्र-संक्˚)
diminishing, lessening, Vcar.
astringent, MW.
सं-˚कोचित n. (fr. Caus.) ‘contraction of the limbs’, a partic. manner of fighting, Hariv.

a: संक्रांत — p. p. 1 Passed through or into, entered into. --2 Transferred; devolved, entrusted; पुत्रसंक्रांतलक्ष्मीकैर्यद्वृद्धेक्ष्वाकुभिर्धृतं U. 1. 22. --3 Seized, affected. --4 Reflected, imaged. --5 Depicted. --6 Having Saṃkrānti (in astr.). --तं Property got by a woman from her husband.

m: सं-क्राम m. passing away, ĀpŚr.
सं-क्राम m. n. difficult passage or progress, L.
a: संक्रामः — Difficult progress; see संक्रम.

m: सं-˚क्रामणी f. a kind of magic or spell, Divyāv.

सं-˚क्रामण—विरोपण n., ‘transplanting’
सं-˚क्रामयितव्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be transported or transferred, Hariv.

सं-˚क्रामित mfn. (fr. id.) transferred, handed over, delivered, communicated, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-क्रान्ता (आ), f. N. of a ch. of the Maitrāyaṇī-saṃhitā.

passed or transferred from (abl.) to (loc.), Kāv.
transferred to a picture, imaged, reflected, W.
(in astron.) having a Saṃkrānti (as a mouth, cf. अ-स्˚), MW.

a: संकुल — a. 1 Confused. --2 Thronged with, crowded or filled with, full of; नक्षत्रताराग्रहसंकुलापि ज्योतिष्मती चंद्रमसैव रात्रिः R. 6. 22; Māl. 1. 2. --3 Disordered, perplexed; U. 2. 30. --4 Inconsistent. --लं 1 A crowd, mob, throng, collection, swarm, flock; महतः पारैजनस्य संकुलेन विघटितायां तस्यामागतोऽस्मि Māl. 1; Pt. 1. 7. --2 A confused fight, melee. --3 An inconsistent or contradictory speech; e. g. यावज्जीवमहं मौनी ब्रह्मचारी च मे पिता . माता तु मम वंध्यैव पुत्रहीनः पितामहः.

confused, perplexed, R.

सं-कुपित mfn. enraged, aroused, excited, MBh.
संकुसुक See सं-कसुक.
सं-कुसुमित mfn. flowering, Lalit.
fully blown or budded, fully expanded or manifested (occurring in the names of various Buddhas).

सं-√ कॢप् Ā. -कल्पते, to be brought about, come into existence, ChUp.; to be in order or ready, ib.; to wish, long for, be desirous of (see सं-कल्पनीय) : Caus. -कल्पयति, ˚ते, to put together, arrange, AV.; to produce, create, BhP.; to move or rock to and fro (the head), R. ; to determine, fix, settle, MBh.; Kād.; to destine for (loc.), MBh.; (with or without मनसा), to will, purpose, resolve, intend, aim at, strive after, AV. &c. &c., to imagine, fancy, take for, consider as (acc. with इव), Daś.; to think about, ponder, hesitate, R.; to perform obsequies, ib.
a: संकॢप् — {c1c} A. To wish or long for. --Caus. 1 To resolve, determine, settle. --2 To intend, aim at, purpose; Ku. 3. 11. --3 To arrange or connect together. --4 To fix, assign, allot. --5 To consecrate, dedicate. --6 To imagine, fancy. --7 To think about, ponder, reflect.

m: सं-कॢप्त mfn. contrived, prepared, made ready, MBh.
desired, wished, intended, ChUp.
destined or meant for (comp.), Āpast.
सं-˚कॢप्ति f. will, volition, ChUp.
thought, fancy, contrivance, MW.
सं-क्षालना (आ), f. washing, ablution, Prasannar.

सं-√ 1. क्षम् (only inf. -क्षन्तुम्), to put up with, bear, endure, MBh.
सं-√ 1. क्षप् P. -क्षपति, to emaciate the body by fasting or abstinence, do penance, MBh.
सं-√ क्षर् P. -क्षरति, to flow together or down, RV.
सं-क्षर m. flowing together, ŚBr.
सं-क्षरित mfn. flowing, trickling, ib.

a: संक्षयः — 1 Destruction. --2 Complete destruction or consumption. --3 Loss, ruin. --4 End, termination. --5 Destruction of the world.

a means of compressing, Suśr.
(pl.) straits, poverty, MBh.
(in dram.) a brief declaration (of willingness to be at the service of another), Sāh.
throwing, W.
taking away, ib.
a: संक्षेपः — 1 Throwing together. --2 Compression, abridgment. --3 Brevity, conciseness. --4 An epitome, a brief exposition. --5 Throwing, sending. --6 Taking away. --7 Assisting in another's duty. (संक्षेपेण, संक्षेपतस् are used adverbially in the sense of ‘briefly, concisely, shortly’).

throwing, W.
taking away, ib.

Ā. -क्षिपति, ˚ते (ind.p. -क्षेपम्, q.v.), to throw or heap together, pile up, Ragh.; to concentrate (the mind), AmṛtUp.; to suppress, restrain, Bhaṭṭ.; to dash together, destroy, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to condense, compress, contract, abridge, shorten, diminish, ib. : Pass. -क्षिप्यते, to be thrown together or compressed or diminished, shrink up, Mn.; MBh. &c.

narrow, short, small, Nir.; Mālav.; Suśr.

a: संक्षिप्त — p. p. 1 Heaped together. --2 Compressed, contracted. --3 Abridged, curtailed, shortened. --4 Diminished, lessened. --5 Brief, concise, short. --6 Restrained. --7 Thrown, despatched. --8 Seized, grasped.
